title: Activation playbook: SDK + API launch orchestration for structured output, streaming, and function bridges
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: Create an activation and runbook for the SDK + API surface shipping structured output schemas, streaming partial responses, and the new function-bridges pattern. The playbook bundles release notes, sample app kits, telemetry targets, cross-team signoffs, and rollback criteria so PM/Eng/Design/GTM can execute a low-friction roll-out for both hosted and Dedicated customers.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized release notes published to docs.redwood.ai and linked in the console release banner
Sample app repo (redwood-replies) updated with streaming + structured-output examples and 3 language SDK snippets
Telemetry wiring validated: canary telemetry dashboard shows latency, token-cost delta, and schema-violation rate
Cross-team checklist completed: Docs review, SDK readiness, Console banner, Support playbook, Partner comms
Canary rollout plan defined with automated fallback to non-streaming endpoints
tasks: Draft release notes and compatibility matrix (owner: Rafael)
Design review for structured-output UX/console snippets (owner: Priya Rao)
Engineering readiness: SDK bindings, streaming client tests, schema registry hooks (owner: ENG leads)
Create samplekits: Node, Python, Go; include server example using function-bridges (owner: DevRel)
Telemetry: define SLOs and create canary dashboard; add alert for schema-violation > 0.5%
GTM assets: launch blog outline, partner email, changelog blurb (owner: Growth)
Support runbook: triage steps, known issues, rollback commands
notes: Key trade-offs discussed on 2026-02-16: keep structured output schema strict to prevent hallucinated fields vs maximize developer ergonomics by allowing optional fields. Decision: ship with strict schema mode ON by default and opt-out flag for permissive parsing; surface both options in SDK snippets. We will monitor schema-violation rate and consider permissive default for next minor release if adoption signals demand.
release_notes_draft:
Highlights:
- New structured-output mode: enforce schema validation on responses and return structured error metadata when types mismatch.
- Streaming partial responses: clients can subscribe to token stream + structured deltas for lower latency UX.
- Function bridges: a light-weight convention for tool integration across SDKs (examples: calendar, email, product-search).
Compatibility notes:
- Old clients will receive a deprecation header when calling structured-output endpoints; a compatibility shim is available in SDK v1.18.
Known limitations:
- Schema validation introduces 0.2–0.8% additional CPU overhead in canonical workloads; telemetry can be tuned per-tenant.
